# Footprint-completion source provenance

Manufacturer originals are cached locally here and ignored by Git because no redistribution permission is assumed. Upstream files are unmodified. Only original engineering transcriptions, manifests, and the explicitly licensed KiCad source extract are committed. No third-party circuit or PCB is copied.

- [TDK source](tdk_source.json): manufacturer B11 April2011 catalogue, printedp72/PDF70, hosted by authorized distributor DigiKey; current exact product page corroboration. Referenced/adapted land dimensions, independently drawn project copper/mask/paste/courtyard. No claim that the old catalogue alone establishes current electrical performance.
- [JST XH source](jst_xh_source.json): manufacturer mounting-surface/package/contact/mate drawings; numeric geometry adapted, no PCB copied.
- [Connector sources](connector_sources.json): JST VH, Phoenix header/mate and Harwin harness drawings/specification; revisions, relevant pages, hashes where bytes obtained, use, changes, license and attribution recorded per source. Samtec comparison did not establish an absolute hot contact bound.
- [JST VH KiCad source](jst_vh_kicad_source.json): original `Connector_JST.pretty/JST_VH_B2P-VH-FB-B_1x02_P3.96mm_Vertical.kicad_mod` from immutable kicad-footprints commitf64dbd713b8e5c0f6d8638d6794cda5938b3c7e7, tag9.0.6. Local bytes verified against GitLab raw source. Project adaptation changes identity/description and removes the external3D-model reference; geometry is unchanged. By KiCad library contributors, [CC-BY-SA-4.0 with KiCad design exception](LICENSE.md); retain attribution/license when redistributing this library.
- [PR7 KiCad source register](pr7_kicad_library_sources.json): prior assignment audit reused for the unmodified1.5mm bare test pad. All other standard footprints remain referenced by their library identifiers.

Additional reference-only inspection of installed KiCad9.0.6 files: `Connector_JST.pretty/JST_XH_B2B-XH-A_1x02_P2.50mm_Vertical.kicad_mod` (orientation cross-check) and `Connector_Phoenix_MSTB.pretty/PhoenixContact_MSTB_2,5_2-GF-5,08_1x02_P5.08mm_Horizontal_ThreadedFlange.kicad_mod` (candidate identity). They are from the same pinned library release and license; no bytes/geometry were copied into the independently drawn XH/Phoenix footprints. Authoritative dimensional decisions use the manufacturer documents above.

Failed direct TDK/Phoenix downloads returned HTTP403 and are not treated as source evidence. TDK's exact product record and Phoenix's current header/mate records were inspected through the web tool; archived manufacturer-authored drawings establish orientation. A live access date is not a fabricated controlled revision. Metadata dates for unnumbered JST PDFs are explicitly identified as metadata, with SHA256 recording the exact inspected bytes.
